admission.justification: Applying an overlay outside the plan can silently drop a tracked path or destroy an unresolved native Git conflict.

applicability: The structural overlay executed after Git's three-way memory merge.
conditions: The structural plan owns only admitted modeled paths.
Non-regular, mode-varying and file-directory-collision paths remain Git-owned.
exclusions: A modeled record still follows structural resolutions, including removal against a mechanical-only edit.
statement: A structural memory merge updates only modeled paths and preserves Git's mode, object ID and stages for each unmodeled path.
